messages:
jessica_cs: Heads-up — Nimbus Labs renewal is coming up. They requested a contract amendment to reduce seats by ~20% and to move billing to net-30. Can we get procurement/invoice + e-sign path clarified?
marc_renewals: I can handle pricing. Do we have the updated SOW that reflects the seat delta?
jessica_cs: Uploaded SOW v3 here — https://files.redwood/nimbus/sow_v3.docx. Changes are just headcount and adjusted monthly commit.
linda_finance: Need the exact billing address and legal entity for the invoice. Also, finance requires a PO before we emit a new invoice — can the customer provide one?
sachin_se: Reached out to their Ops (cc'd) — they said PO-9981 is in flight, ETA 48h. Billing address change: "Nimbus Labs, Inc., 41 Market St, San Francisco, CA" per email.
olivia_csm: @linda_finance they also asked to shorten signature steps — prefer a single signatory on their side.
marc_renewals: Ok, pricing confirmed. New term keeps 12mo but allows prorated seat reduction starting next billing cycle. Will create amendment doc and route for e-sign.
contract-bot: Draft amendment created: /contracts/nimbus/amend_v2.pdf — awaiting reviewer. Click to start e-sign flow: https://esign.redwood/start/AMEND-1768207777
linda_finance: When you start e-sign, please include line item for credit for reduced seats: Invoice should show credit code `CR-REDUCE-20` and new recurring amount.
jessica_cs: Noted. I'll attach the customer's PO when they send it. @sachin_se can you flag if PO arrives?
sachin_se: Will do. Also asked the customer to confirm signatory name and email.
marc_renewals: Sending amendment to legal for one quick clause tweak (liability language), should be done today.
contract-bot: Legal sign-off recorded by @legal_team at 1768209120. Amendment marked "ready for signature".
olivia_csm: Customer replied in-thread: "PO will be submitted by tomorrow morning. One signer: Carla M., CFO (carla@nimbus.com)." :white_check_mark:
linda_finance: Great — once PO is attached I can create invoice INV-2026-0921 with net-30. I'll include both original and amended totals and the credit line.
jessica_cs: Please CC me on the sent invoice so I can follow up if they stall.
marc_renewals: Kicked off e-sign. Link sent to Carla at 1768210204. Reminder email scheduled in 24h if no action.
contract-bot: E-sign envelope created (ESIGN-9987), status: sent. https://esign.redwood/status/ESIGN-9987
sachin_se: Customer confirmed receipt of e-sign link and PO uploaded to their vendor portal. They expect signature within 48h.
linda_finance: Invoice created and queued: INV-2026-0921. Will push to accounting once PO is on file.
jessica_cs: Awesome — tracking this as low-risk for now but keeping on radar until signed + paid. I'll update the renewal tracker.
marc_renewals: If signature clears and PO is present, I'll close renewal in CRM and move to closed-won.
olivia_csm: Thanks everyone — will ping if anything from the customer side changes. :pray:
contract-bot: Update at 1768211299 — ESIGN-9987 status: signed by carla@nimbus.com at 1768211298.
__notes: Single-thread Slack export format: messages is a continuous string with sender prefixes and chronological order. No title field per agents.md.
